title: Problem Overview
content: Erdős Problem #1115: Rectifiable Paths for Entire Functions. Status: SOLVED (Hayman; disproved in general by Gol'dberg-Eremenko)

title: Isfiniteorder

title: Hayman Theorem
content: **Hayman's Theorem**: For entire functions of finite order with sufficiently regular growth, an escape path exists with ℓ(r) = r.
